title: The 8 Best Jointer 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for jointer 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at jointer 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Powermatic PJ-882HH 8-Inch Parallelogram Jointer, Helical Cutterhead
products.blurb: Key specs: 8-inch capacity, Helical cutterhead, 2 HP motor.
strengths: Helical cutterhead with indexable carbide inserts leaves a glass-smooth finish
8-inch capacity handles wide stock most benchtop jointers cannot
Cast iron tables hold flatness under heavy shop use
The reference stationary jointer for serious furniture shops
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: JET JJ-6HHDX 6-Inch Long Bed Jointer, Helical Cutterhead
products.blurb: Key specs: 6-inch capacity, Helical cutterhead, Cast iron tables.
strengths: Helical cutterhead at a lower price than most 8-inch equivalents
6-inch capacity covers the vast majority of furniture and cabinet stock
Enclosed base improves dust collection significantly
limitations: Cannot flatten stock wider than 6 inches

products.name: WEN JT833H 10-Amp 8-Inch Spiral Benchtop Jointer
products.blurb: Key specs: 8-inch capacity, Spiral cutterhead with 16 staggered HSS blades, Benchtop footprint with extendable table.
strengths: 8-inch capacity in a benchtop machine at a fraction of stationary jointer prices
Spiral cutterhead delivers a cleaner finish than a typical budget straight-knife benchtop unit
Compact footprint fits a home shop without a dedicated jointer bay
limitations: Individual HSS blade segments still need periodic rotation or replacement
Motor bogs on aggressive cuts in hard species
features: Spiral cutterhead with 16 staggered HSS blades
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: WEN 6559 6-Inch 10-Amp Benchtop Jointer
products.blurb: Key specs: 6-inch capacity, 2-knife straight HSS cutterhead, Compact benchtop.
strengths: Solid cast aluminum tables and fence at a genuine benchtop price point
Compact enough for a shop without floor space for a stationary machine
Onboard dust port keeps the work area clear during extended jointing passes
limitations: Straight knives need more frequent adjustment than a helical head
Smaller table length limits control on longer boards

products.name: WEN JT630H 10-Amp 6-Inch Spiral Benchtop Jointer
products.blurb: Key specs: 6-inch capacity, 12 staggered HSS spiral blades, Adjustable infeed/outfeed tables.
strengths: Spiral cutterhead at a price close to straight-knife benchtop machines
Staggered blade arrangement reduces noise and tearout compared to straight knives
Adjustable tables give more control over depth of cut than most budget benchtop units
limitations: Fence adjustment mechanism feels less refined than Jet or Powermatic
Aluminum tables are less rigid than the cast iron tables on stationary machines
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Delta 37-071 6-Inch MIDI-Bench Jointer
products.blurb: Key specs: 6-inch capacity, Straight knife cutterhead, Cast iron construction.
strengths: Delta's cast iron construction has decades of proven reliability in production shops
Compact MIDI-bench footprint suits a home shop without a dedicated stationary jointer bay
Straightforward knife adjustment once set up correctly
limitations: No helical cutterhead option at this price
Table length is shorter than a full stationary jointer's

products.name: Shop Fox W1857 8-Inch Dovetail Jointer with Mobile Base
products.blurb: Key specs: 8-inch capacity, 4-knife straight HSS cutterhead, 3 HP motor.
strengths: 8-inch dovetail-ways stationary jointer capacity at a meaningfully lower price than Powermatic
3 HP motor handles wide hardwood without bogging
Built-in mobile base and cast iron construction match stationary jointer standards
limitations: No helical cutterhead option on this model
Parts and service network smaller than major brands
features: Cast iron tables with built-in mobile base

products.name: POWERTEC 6-Inch Jointer Blades, Set of 3 (148030)
products.blurb: Key specs: High speed steel, 6-inch length, Set of 3.
strengths: High speed steel holds an edge well through repeated resharpening
Direct fit replacement for common 6-inch straight-knife jointers like the Delta 37-190/37-195 and Jet JJ-6CS
Restores factory-fresh cut quality at a low cost
limitations: Setting knife height precisely takes practice
Not a fit for helical cutterhead machines
features: Fits common 6-inch Delta and Jet straight-knife jointers
